lines.en: label nikisummer2nightgen:
scene nikisummer2nightgen
I call Niki a little bit later than normal to find that she’s holed up in some fancy hotel in the urban district.
lines.zh: 我比平时晚一点给 Niki 打电话，发现她正窝在市中心某家高级酒店里。

lines.en: Her mild inebriation at the time of my calling somehow converts into full on drunkenness by the time I get there and the two of us spend the night relaxing on the bed and talking about life.
lines.zh: 我打电话时她只是微醺，等我赶到那儿时已经变成了彻头彻尾的烂醉，于是我们俩整晚都赖在床上聊人生。

lines.en: Of course, being that the two of us are on a mattress and my libido is ten times greater than that of an average male, I attempt to turn our conversation into something more.
lines.zh: 当然，既然我们俩同在一张床垫上，而我的性欲又是普通男性的十倍，我便试图把话题引向别的方向。

lines.en: Unfortunately, Niki becomes an even bigger bitch when she is intoxicated and spends the rest of the night teasing me and blocking me from making any sort of move.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，Niki 喝醉之后会变成一个更难缠的泼妇，剩下的整晚都在挑逗我、拦着我不让我有任何进一步的动作。

lines.en: I continue to press on in hopes of changing that and eventually come extremely close, only to have her pass out minutes later.
lines.zh: 我不停地试探，希望能扭转局面，最后几乎就要得手了，结果几分钟后她就直接睡死了过去。

lines.en: scene black
While my mission to hook up with an idol may have failed tonight, I am sure there will be many victories to come in the foreseeable future.
lines.zh: 虽然今晚“勾搭偶像”的任务失败了，但我相信在可预见的未来还会有许多次胜利。

lines.en: I’m just not sure if any of them will come while Niki is under the influence.
lines.zh: 我只是不确定其中会不会有一次发生在 Niki 喝醉的时候。

lines.en: I guess that’s kind of a good thing, though, as it makes my moral compass appear a lot stronger than it actually is- and prevents {i}her{/i} from doing something she may potentially regret.
lines.zh: 不过我想这大概是件好事——它让我的道德指针看起来比实际坚固得多，也免得{i}她{/i}做出日后可能会后悔的事。

lines.en: Not that I think she’d regret anything happening between the two of us when tons of things have {i}already{/i} happened.
lines.zh: 我不是说她会后悔我们之间发生过什么——毕竟该发生的{i}早就{/i}发生过了。

lines.en: What I think she’d regret is not remembering it.
lines.zh: 我觉得她会后悔的，是不记得那件事。

lines.en: Either way, seeing as she is now unconscious and I have nothing else to do, I take it upon myself to summon a ride back home and hope silently along the way that my next trip to a hotel will have a happy ending.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，既然她现在已经不省人事，而我又无事可做，我便自己叫了辆车回家，一路上默默祈祷下一趟酒店之行能有个圆满的结局。
